# SprayFoamRigTech

> A Contractors Choice Agency resource explaining spray foam rig equipment: the proportioner, spray gun, heated hoses, and generator, plus maintenance, troubleshooting, and why equipment quality matters for the finished job. Plain, mechanical, vendor-neutral — not a sales page for any manufacturer.

## Equipment Guides
- [What Is a Spray Foam Rig?](https://sprayfoamrigtech.com/what-is-a-spray-foam-rig): The core components explained — proportioner, spray gun, heated hoses, generator.
- [Rig Maintenance & Troubleshooting](https://sprayfoamrigtech.com/rig-maintenance-and-troubleshooting): Routine maintenance tasks and how to diagnose off-ratio spray foam.
- [Why Rig Quality Matters](https://sprayfoamrigtech.com/why-rig-quality-matters): How equipment condition connects directly to cell structure, adhesion, and cure quality.
- [Get Matched](https://sprayfoamrigtech.com/get-matched): Free, no-obligation matching with a licensed, insured spray foam contractor from the Contractors Choice Agency network.
